competences: The learner locate activities and times in a daily plan.
The learner answer questions about the sequence of planned events.
languageCompetence: Pronounces, reads, spells and uses correctly: timetable, restaurant, photographs, vehicle, lunch.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to locate activities and times in a daily plan.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to answer questions about the sequence of planned events.
priorKnowledge: Learners have read a weekly plan and can read clock times.
references: P 4 ENG & SST Lesson Notes Term III 2023

steps.content: Learners have read a weekly plan and can read clock times. Key words: timetable, restaurant, photographs, vehicle, lunch
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays mukaga daily timetable chart and links the chart to the prior knowledge: Learners have read a weekly plan and can read clock times. The teacher pronounces the lesson vocabulary, checks learners’ reading, and introduces reading: mukaga’s daily plan.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall familiar words, read the displayed key words aloud, and explain what they already know about the topic.

steps.content: Mukaga’s plan: morning: 8:00 a.m.: Breakfast at Doso’s restaurant. 8:30 a.m.: Board a vehicle to Entebbe with friends. 10:30 a.m.: Get a special-hire taxi to the zoo. 11:00 a.m.: Look at different animals and birds.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: 8:00 a.m.: Breakfast at Doso’s restaurant. 8:30 a.m.: Board a vehicle to Entebbe with friends. 10:30 a.m.: Get a special-hire taxi to the zoo. 11:00 a.m.: Look at different animals and birds. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Where will Mukaga go tomorrow?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

steps.content: Mukaga’s plan: afternoon: 12:30 p.m.: Take photographs at the zoo. 1:00 p.m.: Have lunch with friends. 2:00 p.m.: Swim with friends. 2:45 p.m.: Board a vehicle back to Jinja.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: 12:30 p.m.: Take photographs at the zoo. 1:00 p.m.: Have lunch with friends. 2:00 p.m.: Swim with friends. 2:45 p.m.: Board a vehicle back to Jinja. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Where will he have breakfast?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

steps.content: Example: locating an activity: At what time will he have lunch? He will have lunch at 1:00 p.m.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: At what time will he have lunch? He will have lunch at 1:00 p.m. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "With whom is he going to Entebbe?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: At what time will he have lunch

steps.content: Where will Mukaga go tomorrow? Where will he have breakfast? With whom is he going to Entebbe? What will Mukaga do at 11:00 a.m.? What will he do after looking at the animals?
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher gives the following sourced text-based exercise: Where will Mukaga go tomorrow? Where will he have breakfast? With whom is he going to Entebbe? What will Mukaga do at 11:00 a.m.? What will he do after looking at the animals? The teacher checks learners’ written answers for meaning, spelling and punctuation, using this key: Mukaga will go to the zoo in Entebbe tomorrow. He will have breakfast at Doso’s restaurant. He is going to Entebbe with his friends. Mukaga will look at different animals and birds at 11:00 a.m. He will take photographs at the zoo.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer individually in their books, use full sentences when required, read selected answers aloud, and correct spelling or punctuation after feedback.

steps.content: Key answers: Mukaga will go to the zoo in Entebbe tomorrow. He will have breakfast at Doso’s restaurant. He is going to Entebbe with his friends. Mukaga will look at different animals and birds at 11:00 a.m. He will take photographs at the zoo.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher revisits these questions: Where will Mukaga go tomorrow? Where will he have breakfast? With whom is he going to Entebbe? The teacher checks whether learners have met the objectives, explains any remaining errors using the source text, and assigns the final exercise item for correction.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners explain their answers with evidence from the text, read corrected sentences aloud, and note the final item for homework.

source.quote: What will he do after looking at the animals

assessment: Check oral reading and written responses to these questions: Where will Mukaga go tomorrow? Where will he have breakfast? With whom is he going to Entebbe? Mark meaning, spelling, sentence structure and punctuation against the displayed source models.
homework: Complete or correct the following source exercise item, writing the answer neatly: What will he do after looking at the animals?
